Principles of the demanding week
The aim of this section is to explain the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk: passenger safety rules for animal travel

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways shall give clear guidance before acceptance, and staff shall confirm that the animal, crate, and documents are ready for carriage. The welcome team must use calm, respectful language and must not promise approval until all checks are complete. If a traveler presents a rabbit file, <<FACT F082>> and the record shall be reviewed with the same care given to every live animal case.

Before acceptance, staff shall inspect the crate for secure latches, clean bedding, and sufficient space for the animal to stand and turn without strain. <<FACT F070>> A crate with damage, sharp edges, or poor ventilation shall not be accepted. The traveler shall be told to correct the fault before presentation at the desk or at the ramp. The desk shall also confirm that labels are readable and that the carrier is suitable for the cabin or hold request.

For larger animals, the combined weight of the pet and crate must be checked against acceptance limits. <<FACT F063>> If the stated limit is exceeded, staff shall decline carriage and direct the traveler to an alternate arrangement. The desk shall record the result in the handling file and shall advise the loading team of any special needs, including quiet placement and careful lifting.

If any detail is unclear, contact the senior coordinator at Aurelia Skyways immediately.
